title: 高盛观点：标普盈利有望再迎双位数增长
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: And so you were writing last week around this idea of the earnings and where we stand in the deceleration.
segments.zh: 你上周写到盈利以及我们目前所处的减速阶段。

segments.en: Because I think a lot of people looked at this or passed earnings season.
segments.zh: 因为很多人看了这个或刚过去的财报季。

segments.en: See 30% growth and say, okay, this is going to be impossible to repeat.
segments.zh: 看到30%的增长就说，这不可能重复。

segments.en: This is a bubble and it's going to pop just in earnings. How do you see the pace of earnings moving forward from here?
segments.zh: 这是个泡沫，盈利会破灭。你怎么看未来的盈利增速？

segments.en: Great to hear that question in my conversations that anxiety constantly talking with investors.
segments.zh: 很高兴听到这个问题，我和市场参与者交流时这种焦虑不断出现。

segments.en: To some extent, defining a bubble as a semantic game.
segments.zh: 某种程度上，定义泡沫是语义游戏。

segments.en: But I think there are two key reasons why investors shouldn't be so anxious.
segments.zh: 但我认为市场参与者不应如此焦虑有两个关键原因。

segments.en: First is, a bubble implies that we're going to see earnings pop.
segments.zh: 首先，泡沫意味着盈利会突然下跌。

segments.en: We just updated our forecasts last week. I think you should expect double-digit earnings growth again next week.
segments.zh: 我们上周刚更新预测。预计下周盈利将再次实现两位数增长。

segments.en: And then the second issue, of course, is that these fears are pretty well socialized.
segments.zh: 其次，这些担忧已被广泛讨论。

segments.en: Investors are anxious about them. And you can see it reflected in positioning data.
segments.zh: 市场参与者对此感到焦虑，这反映在仓位数据中。

segments.en: Our positioning indicator now is at the lowest level it's been since March.
segments.zh: 我们的仓位指标目前处于3月以来最低水平。

segments.en: Which I think reflects these anxieties I'm hearing every day.
segments.zh: 这反映了我每天听到的这些焦虑情绪。

segments.en: Towards the position, I think that's right. I think there's a little bit of a pain trade where everyone was a little reluctant into the midterm elections and to sort of the supply shock sort of story just maintaining and off some, you know, pressuring margins
segments.zh: 对于仓位，我认为这是对的。存在一些痛苦交易，大家在中期选举前有些犹豫，供应冲击的故事持续，利润率承压。

segments.en: and keeping kind of management on their toes. All that now is sort of becoming more accepted.
segments.zh: 让管理层保持警惕。所有这些现在都变得更被接受了。

segments.en: Now, the positioning to your point, is it really just even?
segments.zh: 现在，仓位如你所说，真的只是均衡吗？

segments.en: Is it retail's heavier? And then maybe we have some more sort of institutional guys that need to catch up?
segments.zh: 散户更重吗？然后可能有一些机构需要追赶？

segments.en: Because that's kind of what it smells like. It seems pretty diversified.
segments.zh: 因为感觉就是这样。看起来相当多样化。

segments.en: We've seen cash balances rise among mutual funds. We've seen net leverage decline for hedge funds.
segments.zh: 我们看到共同基金现金余额上升，对冲基金净杠杆下降。

segments.en: I wouldn't say retail positioning is depressed, but we haven't seen the magnitude of inflows over the last several weeks that we saw earlier this year.
segments.zh: 我不会说散户仓位低迷，但过去几周流入规模不如今年早些时候。

segments.en: So you have earnings to back these things up, Ben?
segments.zh: 那么本，你有盈利来支撑这些吗？
